question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Haste
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Haste"** means excessive speed or urgency of movement or action; hurry. (जल्दी)

 
 
• **Example: **In his haste to leave, he forgot his keys on the table.
 
 
 
• **"Delay" **refers to making someone or something late or slow; a period of time by which something is late or postponed. (विलंब)
 
 
• **Example: **The flight was delayed due to bad weather conditions.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'haste' **is **'delay'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Speed** (गति): The rate at which someone or something moves or operates.

 
 
• **Example: **He increased his speed to overtake the car in front.
 
 
 
• **Twist** (मोड़): Form into a bent, curling, or distorted shape.
 
 
• **Example: **She twisted her ankle while running.
 
 
 
• **Quick** (तेज़): Moving fast or doing something in a short time.
 
 
• **Example: **He made a quick decision to avoid the accident.
